title: Daraar
desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy businessman, falls for Priya Bhatia, a charming real estate agent. But when he proposes, his world shatters-Priya is already married.

title: Run
desc: Jhanvi and Siddharth are deeply in love, but her brother Ganpat, a gangster, disapproves of their relationship and plots to kill Siddharth.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: A commoner named Prem swaps places with Prince Vijay Singh before a tense coronation. As plots unfold, Princess Maithili, meant to wed Vijay, finds herself drawn to Prem.

title: Raazi
desc: Sehmat Khan, a brave RAW agent, marries into a Pakistani family at her father's request. Her mission is dangerous-gathering crucial enemy secrets while risking her life.

title: Jaat
desc: In a quiet coastal village ruled by fear, Varadaraja Ranatunga's tyranny goes unchecked-until a wandering stranger's clash with his men exposes the villagers' silent suffering.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
desc: Pawan, a devotee of Lord Hanuman, finds a girl, who is speech impaired, lost in Haryana. He soon learns that she belongs to Pakistan and sets out to reunite her with her family at great personal cost.

title: Silsila Hai Pyar Ka
desc: Vanshika, a simple young woman, is hired by a wealthy man to care for his son. Though the boy is spoiled at first, her presence slowly changes his outlook and their lives forever.

title: Jism
desc: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls for Sonia, wife of a wealthy traveler. She lures him into murdering her husband, but her shocking motive leaves Kabir stunned.

title: Koyla
desc: Shankar, a mute servant, tricks Gauri into marrying his employer with a false photo. But Gauri falls for Shankar, fighting against odds to be with him.

title: Sanam Teri Kasam
desc: When Saraswati is thrown out by her father, Inder stands by her through every hardship, bringing them closer. But just as love blooms, destiny intervenes with plans to tear them apart.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: De De Pyaar De 2
desc: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

title: Khaali Peeli
desc: Childhood sweethearts Pooja and Blackie reunite years later when she escapes a brothel and crosses paths with him, now a taxi driver, leading to an emotional, action-packed journey.
